flows:
Navigate to https://www.sfmta.com/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
Assert that the visible Play/Pause control for the homepage carousel is keyboard focusable.
Activate it with Tab and Enter to pause the carousel.
Verify the control reports aria-pressed false.
Keyboard navigation: From fresh page focus, press Tab repeatedly, about twenty times total, to reach Play/Pause directly after the carousel page indicator.
Avoid reversing direction.
Once Play/Pause has focus, press Enter once and read its pressed state.

summary:
The carousel’s Play/Pause control is being skipped in the page’s keyboard focus order, so keyboard-only visitors cannot reach it to pause the moving carousel.
Make the visible carousel Play/Pause button a normal keyboard-focusable control and place it immediately after the carousel page indicators in the forward Tab order. Then verify that Enter pauses it and its pressed state changes as announced.
evidence: objective_contradiction: Twenty forward Tabs skipped Play/Pause and focused Starting Location, so the requested focused control was not reached.
one_liner: The homepage carousel’s visible Play/Pause control could not be reached with Tab before focus moved to the Starting Location field.
